name: photosynthetic_capacity
provenance: Reasoned. P = aMax(aMaxFrac+baseFolRespFrac)/cFracLeaf. Median 251 (aMax 123 nmol g-1 s-1, ~8 umol m-2 s-1 at the BETY SLA); 2.5% 140 ~ BETY Amax*SLA 97.5% (P 170) and below template (228); 97.5% 450 ~ top-canopy oak leaf Amax ~13 umol m-2 s-1 (approximate literature). Upper end cut from 500 after i4's GPP tail.

name: respiration_share
provenance: Reasoned from BETY: area Rd 0.66 umol m-2 s-1 over leaf gross Amax 6-15 gives 0.04-0.10; upper end reaches BETY's baseFolRespFrac-based 0.16.

name: optimum_photosynthesis_temperature
reaches_sipnet: Copy -> optimum_photosynthesis_temperature (psnTOpt); DerivedParameter min = topt - 23.96 -> Copy min_photosynthesis_temperature (psnTMin)
provenance: Reasoned: temperate-deciduous canopy optimum ~20-27 C (approximate literature); BETY median 43 C rejected (phase 1). psnTMin follows at fixed range psnTOpt-psnTMin = 23.96 C.

name: soil_water_holding_capacity
provenance: Reasoned placeholder: from plant-available water of a ~1 m stony sandy-loam rooting zone (~15 cm, inferred) to past PEcAn's porosity x 2 m (88). Above ~88 the model is water-unlimited here (flat direction).

name: leaf_on_growth
provenance: BETY 2.5% (50) kept; upper end cut from BETY 249 to 180 (LAI 5.9 at leafCSpWt 30.7): the pulse should not exceed a full Harvard canopy (reasoned).

name: leaf_on_growing_degree_days
provenance: Driver-based: SIPNET GDD (base 0 C, sipnet.c:230-235) reaches 500 on DOY ~123, 700 on ~139, 800 on ~145; Harvard canopy develops mid-late May (approximate phenology literature; NEE-onset ~DOY 148 in the calibration data, GDD 847+-119). Median 742.

name: allocation.leaf

name: wood_respiration_rate_at_10c
reaches_sipnet: DerivedParameters r10/vegRespQ10 -> base_wood_respiration_rate (baseVegResp) and r10/coarseRootQ10 -> base_coarse_root_respiration_rate
provenance: Reasoned: base rate referenced to 10 C (baseVegResp = r10/vegRespQ10, sipnet.c:1066-1067); median 0.0155 yr-1 ~ 130 g C m-2 yr-1 at 8.6 kg C m-2 of wood; BETY stem draws judged unconstrained (phase 1). Also sets coarse-root respiration (tied: coarse roots are wood).

name: soil_respiration_flux_at_10c
provenance: Reparameterization of the Rh ridge: F10 = k10*SOC0, g C m-2 yr-1 at 10 C and M=1; baseSoilResp = F10/(1000*SOC0*Q10). Reasoned: Harvard heterotrophic respiration ~300-700 g C m-2 yr-1 (approximate literature). Pushforward of k10 checked against BETY.

name: soil_respiration_q10
provenance: Reasoned: ecosystem-level Q10 converges near 1.4 (Mahecha et al. 2010, Science 329:838) while soil-chamber apparent Q10s are often 2-4; interval 1.3-3.2, median 2.04.

name: initial_wood_carbon
provenance: Site 4977 initial-condition ensemble (100 members), log-normal fit to the members (log_normal_from_samples).

name: initial_soil_organic_carbon
provenance: Site 4977 initial-condition ensemble, log-normal fit to the members; its upper tail (to ~100 kg m-2) is kept, the SoilGrids observation constrains it.
